feature: Two events on different domains of one entity run in parallel
description: A: 20->30 m/s linear 4 s at t=1. S: brake lights on at t=2. They act on different domains.

clauses: 7.5.1 Conflicting actions (same domain: newer action overrides)
oracle.derivation: SimForge preempts per axis, so the storyboard that expresses this is two events that do not stop each other (priority parallel, or separate Maneuvers). A is not in conflict with a LightStateAction (7.5.1), so it runs to 30 m/s at t=5.

expect.esminiNote: before the F-10 fix our export put both events in one Maneuver with priority=overwrite and esmini (correctly for that file) stopped A at t=2, freezing 22.5 m/s
